_about: Floor-plan sketches for completed condos. Rooms are rectangles traced from the developer's floor plan (Stacked Homes directory); x1,y1,x2,y2 are in the source image's pixels and only their proportions matter. Kinds: room, living, kitchen, wet (bath/WC), hall (corridor/foyer), study, balcony, ledge (AC ledge), planter, bay, yard, shelter (household shelter), store. RC ledges that the developer excludes from the strata area are left out. The build draws each plan as an SVG under assets/fp/ and works out the balcony and ledge shares unless the developer states them (stated: [balcony sqm, ledge sqm, total sqm]).
